RPN Calculator

A real stack-based Reverse Polish Notation calculator: type numbers, press Enter to push, then apply + − × ÷, with drop, swap and clear stack operations.

Stack (X = top)

Stack is empty — type a number and press Enter.

📖 How to use

  1. Type a number with the digit keys (or your keyboard) and press Enter to push it on the stack.
  2. Type the second number and press an operator key (+ − × ÷) — it pops the top two values, computes, and pushes the result.
  3. Use Drop to remove the top value, Swap to exchange the top two, Clear to empty the stack.
  4. The X register (top of stack) always shows the current result.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How does RPN work?

In Reverse Polish Notation you enter operands first, then the operator: 3 Enter 4 + gives 7. No equals key and no parentheses are needed — the stack order handles precedence.

What do Drop and Swap do?

Drop removes the top stack value (X). Swap exchanges X with Y (the second value), which is handy before a subtraction or division when the operands are in the wrong order.

Can I use my keyboard?

Yes — digits, decimal point, Enter (push), + - * /, Backspace to edit the entry, and Escape to clear the stack all work from the keyboard.
